items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produces proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture [pdf]
items.whyItMatters: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produced a formal proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture — rare for an LLM to tackle open math and get it right.

items.title: Mesh LLM: distributed AI computing on iroh
items.whyItMatters: Distributes LLM inference over iroh's IPFS mesh — decentralized compute could change how you run models without centralized GPU vendors.

items.title: Ghost Font: A font that humans can read but AI cannot
items.whyItMatters: A font legible to humans but adversarial to OCR and vision models — practical demonstration of data poisoning at the UI layer.

items.title: GPT-5.6, Grok 4.5, Claude, and Muse Spark build the same 4 apps
items.whyItMatters: Four frontier models (GPT-5.6, Grok 4.5, Claude, Muse) converged on identical app designs from the same brief — reveals how model output space is compressing.
